patthana13.21:1.1: ajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: …pe…
patthana13.21:2.1: hetuyā cha …pe… sanidassanattike nasanidassanattikaṃ anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho ca na anidassanasappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanasappaṭigho ca na anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: anidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho ca na anidassanaappaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: cha.
